nodes.label: map { meta -> mapping fields header + values }

nodes.label: ch_mappings.filter { sample_mapping_fields }
nodes.notes: Filters on a value, not on the items: passes everything or nothing.

nodes.label: channel.topic('versions')
nodes.notes: Every process emits its versions to this topic. The preview DAG does not draw that wiring: each emit is a loose point, and the topic is a separate source point.
